pairs.question: Quomodo conciperem quae virum non cognovi? Qualiter infringerem quod firma mente vovi?
pairs.answer: Spiritus Sancti gratia perficiet haec omnia.
pairs.derivation: Mary asks the angel how she can conceive (genuine interrogative: quomodo... qualiter...) without having known a man. Her words form stanza 2 with no internal framing to strip. The angel's reply opens with the operative answering sentence 'Spiritus Sancti gratia perficiet haec omnia' (the grace of the Holy Spirit will accomplish all this) which directly answers the 'how'. Cut after 'omnia' at the first full stop; what follows ('ne timeas, sed gaudeas...') is reassuring elaboration, not the answer. Layout artifacts (the '- ... / ... / ...' indented line breaks) carry no extra words for this span.
